topic: From Circles to Heat: The Magic of Fourier Series

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Geometry of Cycles
lecture_lines: Euler's formula describes rotation via complex numbers.
We represent this as a phasor tracing a circle.
Rotation in the complex plane creates a cycle.
animations: Draw a unit circle centered at (0,0) in #FFFFFF using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/compass.svg] as a guide for the circular path.
Add a rotating point tracing the circle in #FF00FF.
Create a dynamic vector from origin to point in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Epicycles: The Fourier Synthesis
lecture_lines: Fourier series build shapes from epicycles.
Circles added together form complex periodic paths.
Radii and frequencies determine the path's shape.
This synthesis constructs any periodic function.
See how these vectors trace the cat's path.
animations: Display two circles attached in a chain, #FFFFFF and #FFFF00, with a cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] sitting at the center.
Animate both circles spinning with distinct frequencies.
Trace the path of the final endpoint in #FF0000.
Pause animation to emphasize the path formation.
Add a background grid for context in #444444, displaying the cat [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] as a watermark.

sections.title: Connecting to the Heat Equation
lecture_lines: The heat equation models temperature smoothing over time.
Temperature distributions decompose into basic sine waves.
Sharp temperature details dissipate faster than smooth ones.
High frequencies decay quickly in heat flow.
animations: Display a 1D heat distribution curve in #FFFFFF. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/thermometer.svg]
Animate the curve diffusing and smoothing out, #FF8800.
Decompose the curve into three individual sine waves.
Highlight decay of the high frequency wave, #FF0000.
Show final wave sum returning to initial curve shape. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/radiator.svg]

sections.title: Synthesis & Application
lecture_lines: Circular frequencies dictate heat dissipation rates.
Fourier modes describe a ring's cooling.
Temperature evolves through its circular components.
animations: Show an epicycle set [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ring.svg] and a wave side-by-side, #FFFFFF.
Rotate epicycles showing energy transition to heat waves.
